note: Live parity checks that are known Rust-versus-Python divergences. Each path is a leaf and pins the Python and Rust values. Round-trip entries use the same rules. A pattern that names a list or object is rejected, and a [*] wildcard is rejected. Any other difference, or any other value at a listed path, fails the job. A listed path that stops differing fails the job, so this list stays exact. CI prints the list. Contract-board board_effects is wired through Session refresh and the oracle, so broker_board.txt is not listed.

entries.summary: A successful prize capture agrees on fleet, crew, and cargo. The capture log row does not. Rust clear_encounter runs before blank_step, so that row's enemy id, name, strength, boarding progress, boarding_threshold (2 vs 0), and enemy crew (5 vs 0) are empty. The oracle builds the row from the encounter first. The golden file is that Python snapshot; these paths, at these values, are the only ones allowed to differ from Rust.
